text: Adelaide Laetitia "Addie" Miethke (1881–1962), a South Australian educator and teacher, was pivotal in forming the School of the Air. She used the existing Royal Flying Doctor Service radio network to deliver primary and early secondary education to children in remote and outback Australia, where there were too few school-age children for a conventional school to be viable.
